active_continuity: The Western Heaven Demon Lord has defeated Jin Taekyung in the underground prison, leaving him with shattered limbs, exhausted internal energy, and a fatal Internal Injury.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord has left Taekyung alive temporarily and is moving onward through the damaged prison.
Taekyung cannot move independently and expects to die unless circumstances change.
The underground prison is collapsing and remains structurally unstable after the battle.
Taekyung failed to prevent the Western Heaven Demon Lord from proceeding toward the wider assault.
Jeok Cheongang has still not regained consciousness.
Taekyung fears that the Divine Physician and Cheongpung will be captured or killed, but their outcomes remain unconfirmed.
The Western Heaven Demon Lord claims the Tang Clan, Qingcheng, and Emei will be destroyed.
The Heavenly Power Demon has appeared before Taekyung with evidence that his restraining chain was torn away.
open_questions: Can Taekyung survive his injuries and the collapsing underground prison?

Can Cheongpung survive or escape his confrontation with First Fiend?
